# bitbucket_group_members (Data Source)

Lists every member of a workspace group.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "bitbucket_group_members" "release_managers" {
  group_slug = "release-managers"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_slug` (String) Slug of the group to list members of.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier, formatted as "workspace/group_slug".
- `members` (Attributes List) Every member of the group. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--members))

<a id="nestedatt--members"></a>
### Nested Schema for `members`

Read-Only:

- `display_name` (String) Display name of the member.
- `username` (String) Username of the member, if the account still has one.
- `uuid` (String) UUID of the member.
